name: ametista-human-linear-v1
scope: Offline outcome prediction only; not a playing-strength claim or replacement of frozen engines.

data.validationRule: stable game identity SHA256 first 8 hex modulo 5 equals 0
data.overlapRule: Exclude validation positions seen in training, and test positions seen in training or validation; report both counts.
data.rights: FID offers free download. No explicit open-data or training license identified. Local experimental analysis; do not redistribute source PDN or exported positions.
data.exclude: Malformed, illegal, ambiguous, incomplete or inconsistent-result games; no Kingsrow-derived data.

architecture.encoding: Four 32-square planes: own men, own kings, enemy men, enemy kings; rotate board 180 degrees for black to move; divide features by sqrt(24).
architecture.initialization: All weights and bias zero, no pretrained or manual model loaded.

training.loss: Mean squared outcome error, equal total weight per training game.
training.target: Published game outcome from side-to-move perspective: -1,0,+1
training.algorithm: Deterministic full-batch gradient descent, fixed configuration, no hyperparameter search or automatic promotion.

metrics: Constant predictor fitted only on training
limitations: Published result need not imply terminal board
Game outcomes are noisy labels for early positions
Temporal holdout is not a test against Kingsrow
Shared machine load; run only after resource coordination
